## Motivation

#43927 enables FlashInfer v2's default-tactic (`-1`) comparison on cache misses. Existing v1 winners are accepted before that comparison, and their cache paths did not change. Version the cache identity so fresh startup retunes these configurations with the expanded candidate set.

This continues v2 candidate-selection adoption with existing v1 persistence.

## Modifications

Add a stable `candidate_selection=v2_default` component to the existing cache key.

All previous cache files become cold once, including caches created since #43927 and MegaMoE namespaced records sharing the file. Existing files remain untouched for rollback; subsequent startups reuse the new namespace through the existing v1 load/save path.

Measurement policy remains unspecified. Cache-disabled behavior, skip controls, streams, and distributed synchronization are unchanged. No managed-store migration or MegaMoE integration changes.

## Accuracy Tests

- Current head `6a32decdb5a216b53f35cfb53659308f223da91c`: existing registered autotune suite **12 tests in 19.625 seconds; 11 passed, 1 CUDA-only skipped**. macOS arm64, Python 3.12.12, Torch 2.14.1, installed FlashInfer 0.7.1.
- Applicable commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed. No new unit test is included in the final diff.
- [Newest-head Base H100 FP8 accuracy](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38825807936/job/116737629686): **2 tests passed in 139.761 seconds**, zero skips; standard and Rust frontend GSM8K scores **0.755** and **0.745**, 200 examples each, required **> 0.70**. Actual checkout `55eb0808e8ca008163a7fa10ff59c4bb2d9a1be3` merges this PR head `6a32decdb5` into upstream `4cca7fcd3e644f22a61c7a6e6b57bb89b568d62a`. H100 80 GB, Torch 2.14.1, FlashInfer 0.7.1.
- [Earlier targeted H100 cache persistence](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38762530869/job/116517436033): existing target/draft cache-persistence case passed on prior head `332a055bae` (identical production code). This is historical validation, not a new-head rerun of that unit case.
- **Base status:** all 16 Stage A jobs and seven Stage B jobs passed. The H100 job above subsequently failed in `TestRustMmMMMU.tearDownClass`: its accuracy test passed, but `kill_process_tree` could not reap a process within 60 seconds after SIGKILL. Eleven other Stage B jobs then failed fast; Stage C was skipped. Full Base remains incomplete pending recovery of this cleanup failure; no retry has been triggered.
- **Coverage limits:** explicit eager/graph numerical comparison and controlled fresh-process cold/warm zero-profiling validation have not run. Passing FP8 startup/graph accuracy does not establish those additional properties.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance measurements or serving-performance claim. Upgrading incurs a one-time startup retune.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Run the existing registered autotune unit suite.
- [x] Documentation: no public API or option changes; cache-upgrade behavior is described above.
- [ ] Complete CI on the updated head; no speed benchmark claimed.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

files.patch:
@@ -175,6 +175,8 @@ def flashinfer_autotune_cache_path(model_runner: ModelRunner) -> Path:
         str(get_parallel().moe_ep_size),
         str(mr.model_config.hf_config.__class__.__name__),
     ]
+    # Retune caches created before FlashInfer's default tactic joined the race.
+    model_key_parts.append("candidate_selection=v2_default")
     # A different skip policy must not reuse previously tuned tactics.
     skip_ops = get_flashinfer_autotune_skip_ops(mr)
     model_key_parts.append("skip_ops=" + ",".join(sorted(skip_ops)))
